instruction: Help me change my screen's brightness to reduce glare and make it easier on my eyes.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because screen brightness is a hardware-level display setting that cannot be programmatically verified in the OSWorld environment. The actual brightness level depends on hardware controls and system settings that are not accessible through standard evaluation methods.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly classified as infeasible - screen brightness is a hardware-level display setting
Brightness adjustments cannot be reliably verified in OSWorld VM environment
Actual brightness level depends on physical hardware controls not accessible through software APIs
The instruction also contains subjective requirement ('more comfortable setting') that cannot be objectively verified
Using 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate choice for this type of hardware-dependent task
